node.title: Re^2: Module Installation Errors
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [dave_the_m|Dave],

The typical pattern in Debian is lib.+-perl, so e.g. libmoose-perl or libmoosex-meta-typeconstraint-forcecoercion-perl. Unforunately, no such luck for libfilesys-diskusage-perl, and [https://www.debian.org/distrib/packages#search_contents|searching the contents of the packages] for [https://packages.debian.org/file:DiskUsage.pm|DiskUsage.pm] only reveals [mod://Sys::Statistics::Linux::DiskUsage] in libsys-statistics-linux-perl.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
